title: Voice deployment
what: How the testbed deploys the voice: testbed.toml's setup, build and deploy, the voice and studio units, the studio's proxy locations, and the Korean pack its screen is generated with, in deploy/.

title: Voice policy values
what: The engine's own policy, policy/voice.toml: how long one synthesis may take and the emotions a voice may be asked to speak with, read once in src/policy.rs and listed by the voices route.

title: Voice settings and context
what: The one settings file every binary and script reads, with the listen address, token, database, data root and the node and web units, and the context of store and unit clients built from it, in src/settings.rs and src/context.rs.

title: Voice store
what: The engine's own Postgres database: voices, names, the voice node list, syntheses, transcriptions, encodings and events, its migrations, and where the voices' weights stand, in src/store/.

title: Clients of other units
what: One temporary client module per sibling the engine calls, the node service and the account service, with the hub's command channel shared by the node shell, each holding only the engine's calls, in src/units/.
